summary: Iteration 3 verification passed: backend regression, current dashboard date, report action feedback, transaction CRUD, account reconciliation, live summaries, and desktop/mobile layout all work against the public app.

integration_issues.issue: Existing controls still only show an informational 'yakında hazır' toast; no create form or persistence flow is implemented.

action_items: Implement account and cari-account create CRUD if those original requirements remain in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: The dashboard date observer and document-level report click listener are global side effects; prefer component handlers/state so feedback is scoped and cleanup is automatic.
Transaction save/delete/import promises do not catch API failures, so backend errors can leave the UI without an error state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (focused final flows passed; account/contact CRUD remains intentionally unimplemented)

seed_data_creation: Created one temporary UI_TEST_final transaction for end-to-end verification and deleted it; backend tests created temporary TEST_ records and cleaned them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Date observer and report-button feedback now pass on desktop. Mobile transactions/dashboard/calendar load without horizontal overflow and calendar navigation works. Recheck account/contact CRUD after implementation.
rca of the issue: Account/contact buttons are wired to informational toast callbacks rather than create flows. No backend account update endpoint or contact resource flow is currently exposed for those controls.
